title: Mandatory Help Desk TPS process accounting
summary: Every closed Help Desk session records its process outcome as a real TPS Report and a linked TPS Report Review. These records immediately become ordinary live NotNotes data for future support queries.
invariants: Session accounting uses the installed TPS Report and TPS Report Review formats, not a private audit store.
The review stores the stable TPS document reference rather than copied presentation text.
Any failed/unknown operation makes the session review FAILURE; otherwise it is SUCCESS.
Later Help Desk sessions discover prior process reports through ordinary live NotNotes relationships.
procedure: At close, create the TPS Report with the session TPS-HD identifier and actor.
Create the linked TPS Report Review with SUCCESS or FAILURE plus turn/success/failure evidence.
Persist through NotNotes authority and let future sessions query the records normally.

provenance.claim: Mandatory session TPS Report and linked review persistence plus recursive support evidence.
